# UITextSizeConstraint

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")`

Keeps the text size of a label with `TextScaled` on between a minimum and a maximum, so the text is never too small to read or too large. It has no effect on a label whose text is not scaled.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `MaxTextSize` | `number` | `100` | read/write | The largest size the text can have, in the object's units. |
| `MinTextSize` | `number` | `1` | read/write | The smallest size the text can have, in the object's units. |
